title: Current user direction
notes: PA0 LED jumper and resistor network intentionally omitted from slice 9; serial baud conflict resolved in favor of the later X64 choice; serial console DE-9 finalized as DCE-style female with SBC TX on pin 2 and RX on pin 3; reset finalized as 10 kohm and 1.0 uF RC plus pushbutton with no brownout supervisor; baud mux control finalized as DIP switch with increasing select codes choosing increasing baud rates; MSM58321 STOP tied low for normal always-running RTC operation; RTC timing finalized as an MC14411-clocked one-hot sequencer rather than 74123 R/C pulse stretching; final chip selects are address-only decode from latched A0-A7 and A8-A12; memory controls use spare gates with DS and direct CPU read/write signalling; LI is intentionally left unconnected because it is not useful enough for debug; SYSCLK TP8 is omitted because AS DS and chip-select pads are sufficient for board debug; IRQ pull-up R8 is 4.7 kohm because IRQ is exposed on J4; RTC uses the selected Abracon 32.768 kHz crystal with fixed 18 pF load capacitors and no trim capacitor; CPU B0-B7 are the multiplexed external address/data pins while PB0-PB7 are separate Port B GPIO pins; 4.7 kohm pull-up networks are staged on B0-B7/D0-D7 PA0-PA7 and PB0-PB7
